meta.name: database
meta.description: Use BEFORE editing any file in `supabase/migrations/` or `supabase/schemas/`, OR when the user runs `/database <subcommand>` (`compact local migration`, `rls scenarios`, `align`). Encodes the three contracts that protect the Grida database layer: applied migrations are immutable, RLS implementation mirrors tests (never the reverse), `schemas/*.sql` is the human-readable end-state. Companion to `supabase/AGENTS.md` (RLS, grants, security boundaries).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理数据库迁移、RLS策略与模式文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用Supabase管理数据库并需要维护迁移、RLS和模式的一致性。
copy.tagline_en: Manage database migrations, RLS policies, and schema files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Supabase and need to maintain consistency across migrations, RLS, and schemas.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你编辑数据库迁移文件或运行 /database 命令时，确保迁移文件不可修改、RLS 策略与测试一致、schema 文件与迁移同步。
howto.when: 当你编辑 supabase/migrations/ 或 supabase/schemas/ 下的文件，或运行 /database compact local migration、/database rls scenarios、/database align 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我合并本地的迁移文件。
say.note: Claude 会分类迁移文件并合并本地未提交的迁移。

say.text: 为 projects 表编写 RLS 测试场景。
say.note: Claude 会生成 pgTAP 测试，覆盖各角色权限。

say.text: 对齐 grida_billing 的 schema 文件。
say.note: Claude 会更新 schema 文件以匹配迁移后的状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude ensures that migration files are immutable, RLS implementation mirrors tests, and schema files stay in sync with migrations when you edit database files or run /database commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you edit files in supabase/migrations/ or supabase/schemas/, or run /database compact local migration, /database rls scenarios, or /database align.

say_en.note: Claude classifies and merges local-only migrations.

say_en.text: Write RLS test scenarios for the projects table.
say_en.note: Claude generates pgTAP tests covering all personas.
Claude updates the schema to match the migrated state.
